claims: Rec Room announced that it will permanently close on June 1, 2026.
Rec Room is scheduled to close on June 1, 2026.
Rec Room management reported that expenses consistently outpaced revenue, making the business unsustainable, according to Rec Room Blog.
Snap Inc. has acquired certain assets from Rec Room, according to GeekWire.
Some Rec Room staff will join Snap Inc. to work on augmented reality (Specs Inc.), according to GeekWire.
Rec Room laid off roughly half its staff in August 2025, according to Rec Room Blog and Game Developer.
Rec Room is winding down operations, according to Rec Room Blog and Game Developer.
Rec Room's shutdown affects its entire cross-platform network, including mobile, console, PC, and VR versions, according to The Verge.
